title: Genotyping Wheat Grains to Identify Parental Donation of Alleles
author: Delfi Dorussen
materials: Preheat the DNA extraction buffer to 65ºC.

steps.title: Prepare sterilisation solution
steps.instruction: Mix 5 mL sodium hypochlorite solution with 100 mL sterile de‑ionised water.

steps.title: Ethanol surface sterilisation
steps.instruction: Treat grains with 70 % ethanol, vortex, incubate, vortex again and discard ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL 70 % ethanol to grains in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Vortex 10 seconds.
Incubate 5 minutes.
Vortex 10 seconds.
Pour off ethanol.

steps.title: Sterilisation solution treatment
steps.instruction: Expose grains to the sterilisation solution, shake, incubate on shaker and discard solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL sterilisation solution to the tube.
Shake to dislodge grains from the tube bottom.
Place tube on a shaker for 15 minutes.
Pour off the sterilisation solution.

steps.title: Wash grains with sterile water
steps.instruction: Rinse grains four times using 10 mL sterile de‑ionised water per wash.

steps.title: Add water to shallow plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 µL sterile de‑ionised water into each well of a shallow 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Dissect grains and allocate halves
steps.instruction: Cut each grain laterally, place embryo half in shallow plate and endosperm half in DNA plate, matching wells.

substeps.instruction: Cut each grain laterally in half with a razor blade.
Place the embryo half in the corresponding well of the shallow 96‑well plate.
Place the endosperm half in the matching well of the 96‑well DNA plate.

steps.title: Seal DNA plate and store
steps.instruction: Cover the DNA plate with a sticky seal; store at 4 °C if extraction is same‑day, otherwise at –20 °C.

steps.title: Seal shallow plate and store
steps.instruction: Seal the shallow plate with parafilm, wrap in aluminium foil and keep at 4 °C for two days.

steps.title: Incubate embryo halves for germination
steps.instruction: After two days, remove foil and let the shallow plate sit at room temperature for 3–4 days to germinate.

steps.title: Sow embryo halves in soil
steps.instruction: Transfer embryo halves to a 96‑cell tray containing standard seedling compost.

steps.title: Defrost endosperm halves
steps.instruction: If endosperm halves were stored at –20 °C, allow them to thaw at room temperature before proceeding.

steps.title: Add bead and homogenise
steps.instruction: Add a tungsten carbide bead to each DNA‑plate well, cap, and homogenise at 1250 rpm for 2 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Place a tungsten carbide bead in each well of the DNA plate.
Cap the wells with microtube caps.
Shake in a tissue homogeniser at 1250 rpm for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add DNA extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 333 µL DNA extraction buffer to each well and reseal.

steps.title: Homogenise extraction mix
steps.instruction: Shake the DNA plate in a tissue homogeniser at 1750 rpm for 2 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Shake the DNA plate at 1750 rpm for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Initial spin of DNA plate
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the plate until 3000 rpm is reached.

steps.title: Incubate at 65°C with inversions
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 65 °C for 45 minutes, inverting a few times every 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 45 minutes.
Invert the plate a few times every 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare isopropanol plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 240 µL isopropanol into each well of a new 96‑well plate, seal and store at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 240 µL isopropanol into each well of a new 96‑well DNA plate.
Seal with a sticky plate seal.
Store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Cool DNA plate post‑incubation
steps.instruction: Place the incubated DNA plate in a 4 °C refrigerator for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Spin before ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly until 5000 rpm is reached.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate and mix
steps.instruction: Add 167 µL 6 M ammonium acetate (stored at 4 °C) to each well, seal, shake 15 s, then store at –20 °C for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 167 µL 6 M ammonium acetate (stored at 4 °C) to each well.
Seal the plate with caps.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
Store at –20 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge after ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate for 8 minutes at 6000 rpm.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to isopropanol plate
steps.instruction: Move 400 µL supernatant from each well to the isopropanol plate, seal and shake 15 s.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL supernatant from each well into the isopropanol plate prepared earlier.
Seal with caps.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Spin and reseal DNA plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly to 5000 rpm, remove caps and replace with a sticky seal.

substeps.instruction: Spin until 5000 rpm is reached.
Remove caps from the plate.
Replace with a sticky plate seal.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA at -20°C
steps.instruction: Place the DNA plate at –20 °C for 15 minutes to precipitate DNA.

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitated DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate for 12 minutes at 5200 rpm.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and dry
steps.instruction: Remove the seal, invert the plate to discard supernatant, and blot on paper towel for 10 seconds.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate seal.
Invert the plate to pour off the supernatant.
Place the inverted plate on a paper towel for 10 seconds to remove remaining liquid.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL 70 % ethanol to each well, centrifuge 12 minutes at 5200 rpm, then discard supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL 70 % ethanol to each well.
Centrifuge for 12 minutes at 5200 rpm.
Pour off the supernatant as before.

steps.title: Dry DNA plate overnight or 65°C
steps.instruction: Leave the plate uncovered at room temperature overnight, or incubate at 65 °C for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Leave plate uncovered at room temperature overnight.
Or incubate at 65 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA with sterile water
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL sterile de‑ionised water to each well, seal and vortex.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL sterile de‑ionised water to each well.
Seal with a sticky plate seal.
Vortex the plate.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Allow DNA to resuspend at room temperature for 15 minutes or overnight at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Or overnight in the fridge (4 °C).

steps.title: Final vortex and spin
steps.instruction: Vortex the plate and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 5200 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare primer mix
steps.instruction: Combine primers and water to a total of 100 µL as follows.

substeps.instruction: 100 µM Vic primer – 12 µL
100 µM Fam primer – 12 µL
100 µM common primer – 30 µL
Water – 46 µL
Total volume – 100 µL
Vortex to mix.

steps.title: Prepare master mix
steps.instruction: Make a KASP master mix scaled for the total reactions, adding 15 % excess.

substeps.instruction: For one reaction combine 2.5 µL PACE/KASP mix with 0.07 µL primer mix.
Scale up for the total number of reactions and add 15 % additional mix.
Vortex to mix.

steps.title: Add master mix to 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 2.5 µL master mix into each well of a 384‑well plate.

steps.title: Add DNA and seal
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL DNA to each well, mix by pipetting, and seal with an optically clear sticky seal.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL DNA to each well.
Pipette up and down to mix with the master mix.
Seal the plate with an optically clear sticky seal.

steps.title: Spin before thermocycling
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the plate until 5000 rpm is reached.

steps.title: Thermocycle KASP genotyping
steps.instruction: Run the 384‑well plate in a thermocycler with the following KASP program.

substeps.instruction: Denaturation 94 °C – 15:00 min
Denaturation 94 °C – 00:20 min ×10
Annealing/extension 65‑57 °C – 01:00 min
Denaturation 94 °C – 00:20 min ×35
Annealing/extension 57 °C – 01:00 min
Hold 12 °C

steps.title: Read plate and call genotypes
steps.instruction: Read the plate in a plate reader and analyse with cluster‑calling software (e.g., KlusterCaller) to obtain four genotype clusters.

substeps.instruction: Read the plate in a plate reader.
Visualise results using cluster‑calling software (e.g., KlusterCaller).
Identify four clusters: homozygous Vic, heterozygous (maternal Vic), heterozygous (maternal Fam), and homozygous Fam.
